item.title: Australia’s 'Man with Golden Arm': How James Harrison’s rare blood saved over 2.4 million babies News24 -
item.description: James Harrison, known as the “man with the golden arm,” donated blood almost weekly for 60 years, helping create the life-saving Anti-D injection. His rare antibodies protected pregnant women from rhesus disease, ultimately saving more than 2.4 million babies across Australia.
